title: 💎 Lifetime Premium, Secret Offer & Smoother Play (v1.0.0) ✨
message: This update brings Lifetime Premium with a secret scratch-card offer, a new update notes screen, cleaner messages and faster sounds.
points: 💎 NEW: Lifetime Premium — Pay once and keep it forever. No ads, every Manual Task unlocked and refuel without ads.
🎟️ Secret Scratch Card — Scratch the gold card on the Premium screen to reveal a special 1-hour Lifetime price.
🎉 Premium Celebration — Confetti, sounds and your own Premium member page after you join.
✅ Premium Badge — The home screen now shows a green PREMIUM badge so you always know it is active.
🔄 Restore Anytime — Your Premium is linked to your Google account and comes back on any device.
🔔 Update Notes — See what is new in every version, right inside the game. Check anytime from Settings.
🔐 Privacy & Ad Choices — Players in Europe and the UK can change their ad choices from Settings.
🔊 Faster Sounds — Buttons and effects are ready the moment the game opens.
💬 Clearer Messages — New, easy-to-read message bars.
